item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1233,"end_unit":1233,"fact_summary":"Sheikh Hasina proposed five measures to increase regional health cooperation at a health conference involving WHO.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.2","6B.6","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The archive headline explicitly attributes the proposals to the Prime Minister.","limitations":["Headline-level evidence does not establish funding, implementation, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1241,"end_unit":1243,"fact_summary":"Sheikh Hasina publicly stated that Bangladesh did not intend to enter a war; the government also maintained that elections could be conducted under the existing legal framework.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.3","2B.6","2B.10","4B.1","4B.8","8B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The relevant headlines identify the Prime Minister or election authorities as the speakers or institutions involved.","limitations":["The archive does not provide the full statements or independent verification of the commitments."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1258,"end_unit":1259,"fact_summary":"Sheikh Hasina urged voters to support the Awami League and led public political campaigning before the national election period.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.8","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The archive attributes the campaign statements to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["Campaign activity alone does not establish whether electoral administration was fair or whether opposition rights were protected."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1266,"end_unit":1268,"fact_summary":"After a Dhaka-17 by-election assault on candidate Hero Alom, four people were arrested; the archive also reports that the Election Commission continued to assert its authority and discussed election administration with an EU delegation.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.8","4B.1","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The arrests and election-management actions are attributed to police and the Election Commission, institutions operating under the government; no direct order by Hasina is shown.","limitations":["The source does not establish responsibility for the assault, the completeness of accountability, or the Prime Minister's personal direction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1269,"end_unit":1270,"fact_summary":"Cabinet records reported that 34 of 65 decisions made over three months had been implemented.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The implementation count is attributed to the Cabinet Division; the archive does not identify which decisions were personally directed by Hasina.","limitations":["The headline does not identify the decisions, their quality, or whether partial implementation reflected realistic timelines."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1273,"end_unit":1273,"fact_summary":"The National Human Rights Commission chair was reported as saying that 40% of children in Bangladesh experienced abuse.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.7","3B.10","6B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The reported finding concerns conditions under Hasina's government but is not attributed to a personal act by her.","limitations":["The headline does not specify the abuse categories, methodology, period, or government response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1310,"end_unit":1311,"fact_summary":"Reports described major delays and incomplete spending in development projects, including an amended development budget with 37,000 crore taka unspent and a project whose deadline had been missed twice.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The failures concern government development administration; no specific personal decision by Hasina is identified.","limitations":["The archive provides headlines rather than project-level records or causal attribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1344,"end_unit":1345,"fact_summary":"Amnesty International called for an end to force against protesters, while the archive reported that 34 students from BUET and other institutions had been detained.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The detentions are attributed to state security authorities; Amnesty's statement is external criticism. No direct personal order by Hasina is shown.","limitations":["The source does not state the legal basis, duration, or outcome of the detentions, nor the Prime Minister's direct involvement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1377,"end_unit":1384,"fact_summary":"The Cabinet approved a draft Cyber Security Act replacing the Digital Security Act, but contemporaneous reporting said the draft retained controversial provisions, including non-bailable sections and continuing effects for thousands of existing cases.","question_ids":["1B.9","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"Cabinet approval and the law's legislative progression occurred under Hasina's government.","limitations":["The archive does not contain the statutory text or establish final enforcement practice."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1401,"end_unit":1402,"fact_summary":"The Election Commission planned a November election schedule and an election app, while reporting also described concern about cyberattacks affecting officials' databases.","question_ids":["1B.9","4B.1","4B.4","4B.9","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The election measures are attributed to the Election Commission; the cybersecurity risk concerned state election systems, without a personal order from Hasina.","limitations":["The source does not show whether the safeguards were effective or whether the Prime Minister influenced the Commission's decisions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1419,"end_unit":1420,"fact_summary":"The Ashrayan-2 shelter project reportedly provided new homes and a new life for transgender beneficiaries, while another report alleged that some financially secure people received shelters and that houses were being resold.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.7","6B.8","6B.9","6B.10","7B.9","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The project is associated with the Prime Minister's Office and Hasina's government.","limitations":["The archive does not quantify coverage, verify beneficiary eligibility, or establish Hasina's knowledge of alleged leakage."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1459,"end_unit":1460,"fact_summary":"Reports described irregularities and corruption in an agricultural mechanization project, while a separate report said two new mining feasibility studies had wasted 120 crore taka.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.6","5B.7","5B.10","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The reported failures concern government projects; the archive does not attribute the irregularities to a personal act by Hasina.","limitations":["Headlines do not provide findings, responsible officials, or evidence of corrective action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1499,"end_unit":1504,"fact_summary":"The archive reported alleged collusion and irregularities in approximately 60,000 crore taka of public procurement, alongside a government instruction to reduce unnecessary spending and a legal provision protecting universal-pension funds.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","6B.9","7B.9","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The procurement allegations are reported by TIB; the spending instruction and pension legislation are associated with Hasina's government.","limitations":["The source does not establish final findings, recovery, discipline, or whether the spending instruction changed procurement practice."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1519,"end_unit":1520,"fact_summary":"The archive reported that Bangladesh's foreign-exchange reserves fell to approximately 23 billion dollars and later to the 21-billion-dollar range amid foreign-loan repayment pressure.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","8B.7","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The reserve condition occurred under Hasina's government, but the reports attribute figures to financial authorities rather than to her personally.","limitations":["The source does not establish the government's causal responsibility or distinguish external shocks from policy effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1562,"end_unit":1564,"fact_summary":"WHO described Bangladesh's dengue outbreak as a warning for the world; the archive reported that private hospitals were refusing some dengue admissions and that the government sought international assistance.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.9","3B.10","6B.2","6B.6","6B.10","8B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The request for WHO assistance is attributed to Bangladesh's government; the hospital failures are reported as system conditions.","limitations":["The archive does not establish the Prime Minister's specific decisions, resource allocation, or whether assistance improved outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1595,"end_unit":1597,"fact_summary":"The government announced that it had secured 100 crore dollars for a climate fund, while Parliament passed measures restricting sand extraction from agricultural land and imposing penalties for land seizure and false deeds.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.10","6B.6","8B.2","8B.6","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The climate-fund announcement is attributed to Hasina at an ECNEC meeting; the legal measures were passed by Parliament under her government.","limitations":["The archive does not show disbursement, enforcement, or environmental outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1605,"end_unit":1606,"fact_summary":"Parliamentary reporting said the Cyber Security Bill was passed despite opposition, while election consultations included warnings that a non-participatory election would lack legitimacy.","question_ids":["3B.8","4B.1","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","8B.2","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The bill was passed by Parliament under Hasina's governing majority; the election warning came from election consultations.","limitations":["The archive does not provide the bill's final provisions or establish Hasina's personal role in the vote."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1657,"end_unit":1657,"fact_summary":"The EU reportedly saw conflict surrounding the election and decided not to send election observers.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.10","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The report concerns Bangladesh's election environment under Hasina's government; it does not attribute the EU decision to a specific personal act.","limitations":["The headline does not specify the EU's reasons, the actors responsible, or the scope of the conflict."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1679,"end_unit":1680,"fact_summary":"TIB reports alleged tri-partite collusion and irregularities in public procurement, including single-bid awards, and reported that such irregularities had increased in the e-government procurement system.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7","7B.9","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The allegations concern procurement under Hasina's administration; no direct personal involvement is established.","limitations":["These are reported allegations and do not establish final legal findings or the Prime Minister's knowledge."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1724,"end_unit":1726,"fact_summary":"Reports described persistent inflation, falling purchasing power, economic crisis, and election-related development-project announcements by the Awami League.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.7","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","8B.1","8B.6","8B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The economic conditions were reported during Hasina's tenure; election-related project announcements were attributed to the Awami League.","limitations":["The archive does not establish whether project announcements were implemented or whether inflation resulted from government policy, external shocks, or both."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1745,"end_unit":1748,"fact_summary":"Reports described capital shortfalls at 15 banks, concerns over banking-sector weakness, corruption in medical admissions, and community clinics in urgent need of repair.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.6","5B.7","5B.10","6B.2","6B.4","6B.5","6B.10","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The conditions concern financial, health, and education institutions under Hasina's government; the archive does not show personal direction.","limitations":["The source provides headline summaries rather than underlying audits, causal analysis, or corrective-action records."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1790,"end_unit":1790,"fact_summary":"Sheikh Hasina called on world leaders to stop war and the arms race and to spend money on children's welfare rather than weapons.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.5","1B.8","2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","6B.1","6B.3","8B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The archive explicitly attributes both statements to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["These are public appeals; the supplied material does not show corresponding domestic policy, spending, or implementation."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied source is an e-clipping archive consisting primarily of headlines, tags, and brief metadata rather than full articles.","Several items describe institutional conditions or third-party allegations and therefore do not establish Sheikh Hasina's personal knowledge, intent, or direct responsibility.","The supplied material covers 2023 but includes entries dated after the initial 2023-2023 period boundary as represented in the archive; facts were retained where the archive labels them as 2023 material."]}
